name: Tune: Helix SR
summary: Puts Helix SR's FSR 4 upscaler (HLX FSR 4) into Steam games that ship FSR 3.1, as a drop-in for the game's own FSR library. Helix SR is downloaded from its official release; EmuDEN lists every file first, keeps the original and puts it back on Remove. Games with anti-cheat are refused.
